title: Finvoice 3.0 and the Finnish payment lines
source: Finvoice 3.0, Finanssiala ry: Finvoice3.0.xsd of 27.9.2023 and the implementation guidelines; the bank barcode (Pankkiviivakoodi) version 4 and the Finnish creditor reference (viitenumero, check digit 7-3-1). Read 2026-10-09.

rules.text: Finanssiala's Finvoice 3.0 schema accepts the Finvoice message beside the page; skipped when it is not installed.
The page states the due date, the IBAN, a viitenumero whose check digit holds, and a bank barcode that encodes that IBAN, total, reference and due date.
